lang_en:
Her thumb was on the pay button for Leh.
Tickets out on New Year's Day.
The hotel was already paid.
I said, wait.
She said I always say wait.
She wasn't wrong.
I held up NakshIQ: Leh, January, skip.
Two out of ten.
Manali, go. Eight out of ten, and not its busy month.
We lost the hotel money.
Left for Manali on New Year's Day.
Sometimes travel intelligence is just saying wait.
NakshIQ.
lang_hi:
उसका अंगूठा लेह के पे बटन पर था।
टिकटें नए साल वाले दिन की थीं।
होटल की पेमेंट पहले ही हो चुकी थी।
मैंने कहा, रुको।
वो बोली, तुम हमेशा रुको ही बोलते हो।
ग़लत भी नहीं थी।
मैंने NakshIQ दिखाया: लेह, जनवरी, स्किप।
दस में से दो।
मनाली, गो। दस में से आठ, और भीड़ वाला महीना भी नहीं।
होटल का पैसा डूब गया।
नए साल वाले दिन, हम मनाली के लिए निकल गए।
कभी-कभी ट्रैवल इंटेलिजेंस का मतलब बस रुको कहना होता है।
NakshIQ.

cover.hook: Her thumb was on the *pay button* | for Leh.

shots: s1: Night, their living room. Close on her thumb hovering over her phone, screen away from camera; he sits beside her on the sofa. (covers lines 1-3)
s2: He puts his hand gently over her phone; she turns to him, exasperated, eyebrows raised. (covers lines 4-6)
s3: He holds up his own phone to her, screen away from camera; she reads it and her shoulders drop. (covers lines 7-8)
s4: She lowers her phone onto the cushion and presses her lips together; he rubs the back of his neck. (covers line 9)
s5: She shrugs, then gives him a small, reluctant smile and stands up. (covers line 10)
s6: At their front door, same night, bags packed; she pulls the door open and he follows her out. (covers lines 11-13)
